scientific_summary: Three independent continuous observations with X1 and X3 uniform on (0,1) and X2 uniform on (0,a) have dependent record indicators unless a=1; the covariance has an exact sign-changing closed form. Independent-coordinate products extend the counterexample to every dimension, correcting the universal non-iid independence claim in arXiv:2602.20416.
limitations: The classical iid and Nevzorov F-alpha independence results are not disputed or claimed as new. The novelty claim is limited to the explicit correction, sign-changing family, product extension, and identification of the factorization failure. A public correction not located in the checked literature remains a residual originality risk.
